examples.chinese: 這個週末我們要去騎腳踏車／自行車。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yào qù qí jiǎotàchē/zìxíngchē.
examples.english: This weekend we are going to ride bikes.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 我姓王，叫宜文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xìng Wáng, jiào Yíwén.
examples.english: My surname is Wang. My first name is Yiwen.

examples.chinese: 我姓小林，叫友美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xìng Xiǎolín, jiào Yǒuměi.
examples.english: My surname is Xiaolin. My first name is Youmei.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

items.wordHook: a 女(woman) with a newborn 生(life) marks the family line → her 姓(surname).

examples.chinese: 我以為今天有考試，其實是明天才考。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān yǒu kǎoshì, qíshí shì míngtiān cái kǎo.
examples.english: I thought there was an exam today, but actually it's not until tomorrow that we have the exam.

examples.chinese: 我以為張先生是那家公司的大老闆，其實他只是個小職員。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi Zhāng xiānsheng shì nà jiā gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, qíshí tā zhǐshì gè xiǎo zhíyuán.
examples.english: I thought Mr. Zhang was the big boss of that company, but actually he is just a small clerk.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese:
我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。
A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le.
A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english:
My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding.
A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 他跑得很快，如果跟他比賽，我沒有機會贏，一定會輸。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, rúguǒ gēn tā bǐsài, wǒ méiyǒu jīhuì yíng, yīdìng huì shū.
examples.english: He runs very fast; if I compete with him, I have no chance of winning—I will definitely lose.

examples.chinese: 元宵節燈會是華人新年的重要活動。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié dēnghuì shì Huárén xīnnián de zhòngyào huódòng.
examples.english: The Lantern Festival Lantern Carnival is an important event for Chinese New Year.

examples.chinese: 我們今天要學第十五課，老師會給我們介紹十二生肖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen jièshào shí'èr shēngxiào.
examples.english: Today we are going to study Lesson 15; the teacher will introduce the twelve zodiac signs to us.

examples.chinese: 從這裡往山上走，你就會看到很多牛。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng shān shàng zǒu, nǐ jiù huì kàndào hěn duō niú.
examples.english: If you walk up the mountain from here, you will see many cows.

examples.chinese: 今天晚會上的表演都非常好看。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnhuì shàng de biǎoyǎn dōu fēicháng hǎokàn.
examples.english: The performances at today's evening event are all very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
examples.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 我還沒去過日本，今年可能有機會去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo Rìběn, jīnnián kěnéng yǒu jīhuì qù.
examples.english: I have not yet been to Japan; this year I might have a chance to go.

examples.chinese: 如果我們對別人好，別人也會對我們好。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen duì biérén hǎo, biérén yě huì duì wǒmen hǎo.
examples.english: If we are good to others, others will also be good to us.

examples.chinese: 我去上課以前，一定會先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù shàngkè yǐqián, yídìng huì xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Before I go to class, I definitely will first eat breakfast at home.

examples.chinese: A:你覺得我可以當老師嗎？ B:如果你想當，一定有機會。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde wǒ kěyǐ dāng lǎoshī ma? B: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dāng, yídìng yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: A: Do you think I can be a teacher? B: If you want to be one, you'll definitely have a chance.

examples.chinese: 我有一些台灣朋友，所以說中文的機會很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìxiē Táiwān péngyǒu, suǒyǐ shuō Zhōngwén de jīhuì hěn duō.
examples.english: I have some Taiwanese friends, so I have many chances to speak Chinese.

examples.chinese: 他明天沒有空，不會來我們家。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān méiyǒu kòng, bù huì lái wǒmen jiā.
examples.english: He is not free tomorrow and will not come to our house.

examples.chinese: 我會寫三百多個中國字。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiě sānbǎi duō ge Zhōngguó zì.
examples.english: I can write more than three hundred Chinese characters.

examples.chinese: 你會說幾種語言？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
examples.english: How many languages can you speak?

examples.chinese: 我不太會用這個牌子的電腦，你可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì yòng zhège páizi de diànnǎo, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: I don't really know how to use this brand of computer; can you teach me?

examples.chinese: 這隻小鳥會飛嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎoniǎo huì fēi ma?
examples.english: Can this little bird fly?

examples.chinese: 他會唱很多首中文歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng hěn duō shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
examples.english: He can sing a lot of Chinese songs.

examples.chinese: 他會唱很多首中文歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng hěn duō shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
examples.english: He can sing a lot of Chinese songs.

examples.chinese: 我不會游泳，你會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng, nǐ huì ma?
examples.english: I can not swim, can you?

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 我不會游泳。宜文，妳會游泳嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng. Yíwén, nǐ huì yóuyǒng ma?
examples.english: I can not swim. Yiwen, can you swim?

examples.chinese: 我會游泳，可是游得不太好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì yóuyǒng, kěshì yóu de bú tài hǎo.
examples.english: I can swim, but not very well.

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese:
大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。
雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin:
Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo.
Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english:
In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better.
Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese:
小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。
我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi.
Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english:
Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes.
My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese:
張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。
我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē.
Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english:
Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate.
My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūnjié shí, bàba dōu huì sòng gébì línjū yī hé píngguǒ, zhù tāmen měi tiān dōu píng'ān, rúyì.
examples.english: Every year during Spring Festival, Dad gives the neighbor next door a box of apples, wishing them peace and that everything goes as they wish every day.

examples.chinese:
因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。
這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō.
Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english:
Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast.
There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese:
我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。
那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne.
Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english:
When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought.
That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，這個海灘上就會看到許多人帶著衝浪板來衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yī dào, zhège hǎitān shàng jiù huì kàndào xǔduō rén dàizhe chōnglàngbǎn lái chōnglàng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, you will see many people bringing surfboards to surf at this beach.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese:
氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。
老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin:
Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn.
Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english:
The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs.
The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese:
我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。
A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le.
A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english:
My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding.
A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese:
不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。
那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin:
Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de.
Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english:
No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural.
That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese:
真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。
青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de.
Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english:
True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you.
Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese:
這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。
張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà.
Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english:
This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes.
Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese:
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。
台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le.
Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english:
My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m.
Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 今天的數學考試我只考了三十分，要是被爸爸知道，他一定會罵我的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de shùxué kǎoshì wǒ zhǐ kǎo le sānshí fēn, yàoshi bèi bàba zhīdào, tā yídìng huì mà wǒ de.
examples.english: I only scored 30 on today’s math test; if my dad finds out, he will definitely scold me.

examples.chinese: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Táiwān shèhuì de rén, shì, wù, zuìhǎo qīnzì lái Táiwān zhù yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: If you want to understand the people, events, and things of Taiwanese society, it is best to come to Taiwan yourself and stay for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 開會時如果老闆突然變得很安靜，也不表達任何意見時，就表示他生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí rúguǒ lǎobǎn tūrán biàn de hěn ānjìng, yě bù biǎodá rènhé yìjiàn shí, jiù biǎoshì tā shēngqì le.
examples.english: If during a meeting the boss suddenly becomes very quiet and doesn't express any opinion, it shows that he is angry.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese:
只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。
石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin:
Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english:
As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better.
Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 醫生一再警告韓先生絕對不能再喝酒了，要不然他的身體情況就會更糟了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yízài jǐnggào Hán xiānsheng juéduì bù néng zài hējiǔ le, yàobùrán tā de shēntǐ qíngkuàng jiù huì gèng zāo le.
examples.english: The doctor repeatedly warned Mr. Han that he absolutely must not drink alcohol anymore; otherwise his physical condition would get worse.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.
examples.english: During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.
examples.english: He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese:
你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。
下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。
昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le.
Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé.
Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends.
After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam.
Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese:
那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。
總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin:
Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá.
Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english:
That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather.
Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese:
這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。
老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù.
Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english:
In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds.
The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese:
那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。
這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin:
Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi.
Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english:
The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically.
This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese:
跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。
A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin:
Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén.
A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english:
Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people.
A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese:
幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。
幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin:
Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái.
Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english:
Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone.
Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese:
中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。
小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu.
Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together.
Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese:
我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。
費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái.
Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english:
Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it.
Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, "lóng" jùyǒu zhòngyào de wénhuà yìyì, dàn "lóng" qíshí shì bù cúnzài de.
examples.english: In Chinese society, the "dragon" has important cultural significance, but the "dragon" actually does not exist.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese:
這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。
弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le.
Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english:
I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test.
Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population growth not only affects the quality of life, but I am afraid it will also cause the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese:
由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。
那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin:
Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì.
Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english:
Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings.
That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese:
每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。
導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin:
Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù.
Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english:
Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing.
The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese:
大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。
淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin:
Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì.
Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english:
Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day.
The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 新電腦有問題，給他很多麻煩，讓他覺得白花錢了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, gěi tā hěn duō máfan, ràng tā juéde bái huā qián le.
examples.english: The new computer has problems and gave him a lot of trouble, making him feel he spent money for nothing.

examples.chinese: 新電腦有問題，給他很多麻煩，讓他覺得白花錢了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, gěi tā hěn duō máfan, ràng tā juéde bái huā qián le.
examples.english: The new computer has problems and gave him a lot of trouble, making him feel he spent money for nothing.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣是一個勇敢、樂觀的人，什麼麻煩、困難的問題都不怕。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn shì yí ge yǒnggǎn, lèguān de rén, shénme máfan, kùnnan de wèntí dōu bú pà.
examples.english: Chen Kexin is a brave and optimistic person; she is not afraid of any troublesome or difficult problems.

examples.chinese: 搬家是一件很麻煩的事情。
examples.pinyin: Bānjiā shì yí jiàn hěn máfan de shìqing.
examples.english: Moving house is a very troublesome thing.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 到國外旅遊時身上別攜帶太多鈔票，否則錢丟了就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Dào guówài lǚyóu shí shēnshang bié xiédài tài duō chāopiào, fǒuzé qián diū le jiù máfan le.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, don't carry too many banknotes on you; otherwise, if the money is lost, it will be troublesome.

examples.chinese: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì bàogào gěi lǎoshī qián zuìhǎo quèrèn yīxià dìzhǐ, wànyī lǎoshī méi shōudào, dào shí nǐ jiù máfan le.
examples.english: Before you mail the report to the teacher, you'd better confirm the address; if the teacher doesn't receive it, you'll be in trouble when the moment comes.

examples.chinese: 姊姊覺得木頭地板很麻煩，因為得跪著擦才擦得乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie juéde mùtou dìbǎn hěn máfan, yīnwèi děi guì zhe cā cái cā de gānjìng.
examples.english: My older sister thinks wooden floors are troublesome because you have to kneel to wipe them to get them clean.

examples.chinese: 對夏天一活動汗就流個不停的女性來說，化妝實在是件麻煩事。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàtiān yī huódòng hàn jiù liú ge bùtíng de nǚxìng lái shuō, huàzhuāng shízài shì jiàn máfan shì.
examples.english: For women who sweat nonstop as soon as they move in summer, putting on makeup is really a troublesome thing.

examples.chinese: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Děng yīhuìr kāihuì shí máfan nǐ fùzé dǎzì, bǎ kāihuì de nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
examples.english: When the meeting starts in a moment, please be responsible for typing and record the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 千萬別帶著笨重的行李去旅行，那會給你帶來很多麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Qiānwàn bié dài zhe bènzhòng de xíngli qù lǚxíng, nà huì gěi nǐ dàilái hěnduō máfan.
examples.english: By all means don't travel with heavy, cumbersome luggage; that will bring you a lot of trouble.

examples.chinese: 今年的年夜飯有很多菜，雞鴨魚肉什麼都有。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de niányèfàn yǒu hěn duō cài, jī yā yú ròu shénme dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This year's New Year's Eve dinner has many dishes: chicken, duck, fish, meat—everything.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
examples.pinyin: 「Jiàoshī Jié」 zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
examples.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

examples.chinese: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dào le tèbié de jiérì, Zhāng xiānsheng jiù huì sòng xiānhuā gěi tàitai, zhēn shì làngmàn.
examples.english: Every time a special holiday comes, Mr. Zhang sends fresh flowers to his wife; it's truly romantic.

examples.chinese: 華人社會中有很多重要的節日，比方(說)中秋節、農曆新年等等。
examples.pinyin: Huárén shèhuì zhōng yǒu hěnduō zhòngyào de jiérì, bǐfāng (shuō) Zhōngqiū Jié, Nónglì Xīnnián děngděng.
examples.english: In Chinese society, there are many important festivals, for instance, the Mid-Autumn Festival, Lunar New Year, and so on.

examples.chinese: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu, nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒmen liǎng gè de fāngxiàng gānghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: I walk east, you walk west; our two directions are exactly opposite.

items.wordHook: Combining 相(mutual) and 反(reverse): 相反 means opposite, contrary.

examples.chinese: 那件襯衫的材料百分之百是棉，穿起來十分舒服。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn chènshān de cáiliào bǎifēnzhī bǎi shì mián, chuān qǐlái shífēn shūfu.
examples.english: The material of that shirt is one hundred percent cotton, so it feels very comfortable to wear.

examples.chinese: 這條棉被是用品質很好的棉花做的，裡面的棉又白又溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo miánbèi shì yòng pǐnzhì hěn hǎo de miánhuā zuò de, lǐmiàn de mián yòu bái yòu wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: This cotton quilt is made from high-quality cotton; the cotton inside is both white and warm.

examples.chinese: 這場籃球比賽我們贏了對方二十分，真是太痛快了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài wǒmen yíng le duìfāng èrshí fēn, zhēn shì tài tòngkuài le.
examples.english: We won this basketball game against the other team by twenty points—it was really so exhilarating!

examples.chinese: 夏天運動過後，喝杯冰冰涼涼的冷飲，感覺很痛快。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yùndòng guò hòu, hē bēi bīngbīngliángliáng de lěngyǐn, gǎnjué hěn tòngkuài.
examples.english: After exercising in summer, drinking a glass of ice-cold cold drink feels very refreshing.

examples.chinese: 除了他以外，我們都會駕駛汽車。 (Prep)。我買了一雙除臭的襪子送給他。 (V)。一百除二的答案是五十。 (Vst)。
examples.pinyin: Chúle tā yǐwài, wǒmen dōu huì jiàshǐ qìchē. (Prep). Wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng chúchòu de wàzi sòng gěi tā. (V). Yībǎi chú èr de dá'àn shì wǔshí. (Vst).
examples.english: Except for him, we all can drive a car. (Prep). I bought a pair of deodorizing socks to give to him. (V). The answer to one hundred divided by two is fifty. (Vst).

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

examples.chinese: 想擁有一段百年好合的婚姻，除了真心的愛情之外，也應重視家庭的責任。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒngyǒu yī duàn bǎiniánhǎohé de hūnyīn, chúle zhēnxīn de àiqíng zhīwài, yě yīng zhòngshì jiātíng de zérèn.
examples.english: If you want to have a marriage that is a harmonious union forever, in addition to genuine love, you should also value family responsibility.

examples.chinese: 除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi biérén yuànyì, fǒuzé nǐ bù gāi qiángpò qítā rén quán àn nǐ de yìjiàn zuòshì.
examples.english: Unless others are willing, otherwise you should not force other people to do everything according to your opinion.

examples.chinese: 時間有時能消除煩惱，不能解決的事就暫時放在一邊吧。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān yǒu shí néng xiāochú fánnǎo, bù néng jiějué de shì jiù zànshí fàng zài yìbiān ba.
examples.english: Time can sometimes eliminate worries; for things that can't be solved, just put them aside for the time being.

examples.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
examples.pinyin: Dàzìrán chúle yǒu gè zhǒng dòngzhíwù, hái yǒu shāndì, píngyuán, héliú děngděng, zhè yíqiè yīnggāi shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de.
examples.english: In addition to having various animals and plants, nature also has mountains, plains, rivers, and so on; all of this was presumably created by God.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
examples.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

examples.chinese: 老闆說，除了緊急情況，下班時間別打電話找他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shuō, chúle jǐnjí qíngkuàng, xiàbān shíjiān bié dǎ diànhuà zhǎo tā.
examples.english: The boss said that except for urgent situations, don't call him after work hours.

examples.chinese: 那家義大利餐廳太貴了，除非打折，要不然我不會去。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìdàlì cāntīng tài guì le, chúfēi dǎzhé, yàobùrán wǒ bù huì qù.
examples.english: That Italian restaurant is too expensive; unless there's a discount, otherwise I won't go.

examples.chinese: 要想擁有好身材，除了注意營養，還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái, chúle zhùyì yíngyǎng, hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to have a good figure, besides paying attention to nutrition, you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese:
中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。
小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu.
Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together.
Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese:
大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。
先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin:
Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě.
Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english:
Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand.
The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese:
我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。
除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo.
Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english:
Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags.
On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese:
我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。
我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo.
Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english:
I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good.
My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese:
大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。
雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin:
Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo.
Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english:
In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better.
Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有很多好處，除了學習語言，還有文化交流的機會。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, chúle xuéxí yǔyán, hái yǒu wénhuà jiāoliú de jīhuì.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits; besides learning a language, there are also opportunities for cultural exchange.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 除夕那一天，要拜完祖先才能吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà yī tiān, yào bài wán zǔxiān cái néng chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, you must finish worshipping the ancestors before you can eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 我的行李很重，除了大衣、外套，還裝了一些書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xíngli hěn zhòng, chúle dàyī, wàitào, hái zhuāng le yīxiē shū.
examples.english: My luggage is very heavy; besides a coat and a jacket, I also packed some books.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 旅行的目的除了看風景，還可以了解那個地方的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de mùdì chúle kàn fēngjǐng, hái kěyǐ liǎojiě nàge dìfāng de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The purpose of travel, besides seeing the scenery, is also to understand the cultural features of that place.

examples.chinese: 第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 除了台北101，你還去過哪些地方？
examples.pinyin: Chúle Táiběi 101, nǐ hái qùguo nǎxiē dìfāng?
examples.english: In addition to Taipei 101, what other places have you been to?

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: 電腦工程師除了維護電腦，還要處理各種與電腦相關的問題。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo gōngchéngshī chúle wéihù diànnǎo, hái yào chǔlǐ gèzhǒng yǔ diànnǎo xiāngguān de wèntí.
examples.english: Computer engineers, in addition to maintaining computers, also have to handle various computer-related problems.

items.wordHook: Putting on a 假(false) persona and deceptive 裝(dress) disguise: 假裝 means pretend.
受(receive) + 歡(happy) + 迎(welcome) → receiving a happy welcome: 受歡迎 means popular.
Combining 平(flat) and 安(peaceful): 平安 means peace.
Combining 草(grass) and 原(source): 草原 means prairie.
